name: StarDojo
description: A benchmark based on the game Stardew Valley to evaluate open-ended behaviors of agentic multimodal large language models in production-living simulations involving farming, crafting, exploration, combat, and social interactions.
reputation: A very recent research benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly of interest to agents and multimodal simulation researchers.
notes: Includes a compact subset of 100 tasks for efficient evaluation; highlights challenges in visual understanding, multimodal reasoning, and low-level manipulation.
